---
config:
  state:
    fontSize: 18
    compositTitleSize: 18
    nodeSpacing: 24
    rankSpacing: 36
---
stateDiagram-v2
  direction LR
  state "paused + unmuted" as paused_unmuted
  state "playing + unmuted" as playing_unmuted
  state "paused + muted" as paused_muted
  state "playing + muted" as playing_muted
  [*] --> off
  off --> paused_unmuted: POWER
  paused_unmuted --> playing_unmuted: PLAY
  paused_unmuted --> paused_muted: MUTE
  playing_unmuted --> paused_unmuted: PAUSE
  playing_unmuted --> playing_muted: MUTE
  paused_muted --> playing_muted: PLAY
  paused_muted --> paused_unmuted: UNMUTE
  playing_muted --> paused_muted: PAUSE
  playing_muted --> playing_unmuted: UNMUTE
  paused_unmuted --> off: POWER
  playing_unmuted --> off: POWER
  paused_muted --> off: POWER
  playing_muted --> off: POWER

limitations: Prepared occupied text regions bound native geometry; exact glyph ink depends on the resolved font.
Declared transparency, intentional data-mark overlap and externally modified CSS are outside this proof.
